set.body:
Owner: design. Consumer: PLS Neuro W1 (repo /Users/bbuchsbaum/code/scala/plsneuro, bd-01M1YVQ3V8ESWPJAYHQFQ3S6GT); W0 public probe FirstLevelWorkbenchProbe.scala. The admitted fd992a0c plus candidate 1d62a1a exposes DesignSchema.matrix, rows, columns, runwiseProjection and runwiseSlice. DesignExports.designMap has scan/column ordinals and presentation metadata but does not carry ColumnId, source fingerprint or retained-row identity, and DesignGraphics has only event trace recipes. A linked full-design overview would otherwise require each application to build this scientific mapping.
Deliver a checked renderer-neutral full-design review export and reusable Intaglio plot/scene recipes. Bind raw or explicitly transformed values to source fingerprint, original ScanIndex/RunIndex, physical sample times and StructuralColumn identity; retain exact selected/omitted source columns and scan exclusion context. Display-only scaling must be declared, handle constant columns, preserve raw values and never change fitting. A runwise view must match native projection and distinguish global source matrix from run-local fitted columns. Selection and export must survive reordered/subset columns and repeated labels. Invalid/stale/mismatched axes must fail explicitly. Respect size budgets; avoid a mandatory all-cell object expansion for dense designs.
Acceptance: shared JVM+JS tests using task, nuisance, baseline, FIR, unequal run lengths/TRs, censor gaps, repeated labels, constant and rank-deficient columns; exact value/identity comparisons, SVG export semantics and downstream native JavaFX review. No application-specific branches. General renderer deficiencies belong Intaglio. Implementation remains open; W0 discovery does not implement this feature.
set.title: Design review: expose identified full-matrix and trace graphics
